recommendation: Keep this source fix. If FHIR-I wants Count-like UCUM '1' semantics for Range boundaries instead, that should be handled as a new explicit tracker because it would relax the Applied FHIR-43501 resolution.
issue_request: FHIR-43501 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 Group. It requested that Group.characteristic.instances[x] only convey non-negative whole-number instance counts; the final resolution changed the type to unsignedInt|Range and required an invariant that minimum and maximum Range values are >= 0 with unit, code, and system omitted.
initial_application: Commit 191fa02f04 changed Group.characteristic.instances[x] from Quantity|Range to unsignedInt|Range and added grp-1, but the invariant used Count-style Quantity rules: a Range boundary value required code, allowed system = %ucum and code = '1', and did not check unit. Later Group invariant fixture commits added passing examples with code '1', preserving that mismatch.
additional_context: Group is an active resource in source/fhir.ini and Group.characteristic.instances[x] is an active element. FHIR-I minutes from 2024-05-06 record the approved decision as positive integers, allowing 0, and changing to unsignedInt|Range. A March 2025 Zulip thread reconsidered Count|Range but did not reopen the Jira or reverse the final requirement to omit unit, code, and system.
reconciliation: Updated source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml so grp-1 requires Range.low and Range.high values to be whole numbers greater than or equal to 0 and requires unit, system, and code to be absent. Updated affected Group invariant fixtures to omit code '1' where they should pass, adjusted unrelated fail fixtures so they do not fail grp-1 accidentally, added a grp-1 failing fixture for unit/system/code, and repaired missing commas in the touched cnl-1 fixtures so the edited JSON parses.
source_changes: source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml: revised grp-1 human text and FHIRPath expression to require Range.low/high unit, system, and code to be empty and values to be whole numbers >= 0.
source/group/invariant-tests/grp-1.p1.pass.json and related pass fixtures: removed code '1' from Range boundary examples so they conform to the reconciled invariant.
source/group/invariant-tests/grp-1.f1.fail.json and grp-1.f2.fail.json: retained a negative-value failing case and added a unit/system/code failing case for grp-1.
source/group/invariant-tests/grp-2.f1.fail.json and cnl-1 fixtures: adjusted Range boundary examples so they do not unintentionally conflict with grp-1; fixed missing commas in touched cnl-1 JSON.
